customers_say: Customers find the water purification unit to be of good quality and reliable, with positive feedback about its appearance, installation, and water taste. Moreover, the water quality after purification is amazing, and they appreciate the free installation service. However, opinions about customer service are mixed, with some praising the brand's support while others report extremely bad service.

reviews.author: SS
reviews.title: Time tested company, SS, good taste.
reviews.body: I wanted SS tank, I did not want MTDS. (Only 100% RO). I wanted only Ca and Mg cartridge (no Cu, no alkaline). Pros: I was told that Aquaguard have stopped using MTDS for almost all their models. That’s when I got interested in Aquaguard. This model is the time tested model but with latest nanopore 2 year membrane. Works smoothly, taste is good. Input source TDS 700. Output 70. Quite silent operation. Looks good. Cons: During installation, technician will bring a wall stand for ₹650, a tap attachment for ₹350 and may add a pressure reducer for ₹650. Prices were ‘surprising.’ Anyway be prepared

reviews.author: smita
reviews.title: Product is good but installation was disappointing
reviews.body: The water purifier itself is excellent and has been working perfectly. However, the installation experience was very disappointing. The installation engineer strongly pushed me to purchase a TDS controller and a water pressure control device, even after I clearly informed him that my home receives PMC water. I felt pressured into buying these additional accessories. After testing, my water’s TDS level was found to be just 7, clearly indicating that the TDS controller was unnecessary. It seems these recommendations were driven more by upselling than by the actual water quality and customer need

reviews.author: kiran kumar
reviews.title: Good product but bad customer service.
reviews.body: The product is good. The customer service isn’t so great though. He wouldn’t show up when he promised that he would. So, please be prepared. He wouldn’t show try to upsell you stuff saying I would need a valve for water pressure or that the TDS is higher than expected etc. when you buy the add on he offers, he wouldn’t give any receipt. Other than the customer experience, the product is good. I tested the TDS before and after installation and the water purifier is working as desired. Before installation the TDS was 404(bore well water) and after installation it is 53. So I am quite satisfied w

reviews.author: #leela nagisetty
reviews.title: Staisfied
reviews.body: I've been using the Aquaguard Delight Aquasaver RO+UV+UF+MC water purifier, and overall I'm very satisfied with its performance. The water tastes clean and fresh, and the stainless steel storage tank is a great feature since it feels more hygienic than a plastic tank. The purifier is compact, works quietly, and the purification process is efficient. Installation was straightforward, and the long advertised filter life is an added advantage that may help reduce maintenance costs. Overall, it's a reliable water purifier with good features, and I'd recommend it to anyone looking for a quality RO+

reviews.author: Mohammad Ahmad
reviews.title: Aquaguard
reviews.body: Great water purifier overall! The purification works well and the water tastes clean and fresh. Docking one star only because scheduling the installation took a bit longer than expected, but the technician was helpful once here. Solid purchase.
